result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: A debt buyer shall not bring suit to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on its claim has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.

claims.claim: A debt buyer shall not initiate arbitration to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on its claim has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.
claims.note: The same condition applies to arbitration.

claims.claim: A debt buyer shall not initiate another legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on its claim has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.
claims.note: The same condition applies to other legal proceedings.

result.summary: The draft tracks §1788.56 and preserves its condition: the applicable limitations period on the debt buyer’s claim must have expired.
